{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float (though not used for this question)
sales['revenue_clean'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter out QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
real_orders = sales[sales['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99]

# Now, compute mean age of all customers who converted, including refunded ones
# The question asks for "customers who CONVERTED", and `converted == 1` means they completed checkout
# Refunded orders still count as converted, just with a refund later
converters = real_orders[real_orders['converted'] == 1]

# Exclude only the -1 values in customer_age (missing data sentinel)
valid_converters = converters[converters['customer_age'] != -1]

# Compute mean age
mean_age = valid_converters['customer_age'].mean()

print(f'Mean age of customers who converted (including refunded): {mean_age}')"}
